entries.title: Pending
entries.text: Opens the Builds page on the Pending view: what is still to build, newest first.

entries.title: Queue
entries.text: Opens the Builds page on the Queue view: open builds in build order. Drag rows to reorder them.

entries.title: Orchestrator
entries.text: Opens the Builds page on the Orchestrator view: each build's phases, model switches and steps.

entries.title: Show every build
entries.text: Stops focusing on one build and shows every build in this view again.

entries.title: Copy a link to this view
entries.text: Copies an axf://builds link to this view with its filter, search and focused build. Opening the link brings you back here.

entries.title: Hide
entries.text: Hides the selected builds. They stay in the store and show under the Hidden filter, where you can unhide them.

entries.title: New build
entries.text: Adds a new build to the active profile. The orchestrator owns it and splits it into steps.

entries.title: Plan editor
entries.text: Opens the full Plan editor (acceptance, previews, media) for plan features.

entries.title: Orchestrator editor
entries.text: Opens the full Orchestrator editor: add builds, edit and move steps, set the orchestrator rules.

entries.title: What to build
entries.text: Describe the build in one or two plain sentences. It becomes the build's name and detail.

entries.title: Opus
entries.text: Pins the new build's first step to Opus.

entries.title: Fable
entries.text: Pins the new build's first step to Fable. Use it for contracts, engines, schemas and migrations.

entries.title: Estimate
entries.text: Your time estimate, e.g. 30 min or 2 h. Builds over 30 minutes are split into smaller steps.

entries.title: Open in the orchestrator
entries.text: This phase is a model upgrade, and only Brett can approve that. Opens the Orchestrator editor, where his own click approves it.

entries.title: Link
entries.text: Copies an axf://builds link that opens this build on the Builds page.
